title: sky130 77 K pipeline rerun from the stock SkyWater tt card (no released 77 K card values or structure); arm A 7 parameters, arm B screened set; with and without g v2
user_instructions: don't start from paper cards, start from scratch
And there's no held out set here cause the goal is to be able to fit real data
Also do the same stuff with 7 parameters and get those things and put in slides as well
Make sure to include the iv curve and stuff for ALL devices for both parameter counts for all devices

known_before.template_check: stock template vs full sky130.lib.spice section tt: max relative curve difference 0 on 18 devices

template.temperature: .options temp=-196.15 (deck convention of all earlier runs and of upstream sweeps.spice)

boxes.rule: cold_start.half_width unchanged: vth0 ln 3, other PARAMS7 ln 100, others ln 3; rounds 2-3 next_round_spec shrink 0.5, edge 0.9, min ln 1.05
boxes.why: fixed prior choice applied unchanged to every device; not tuned on the stock-card result (limitation: set in October with the released multiplier range known)

g_v2.inner: I15-2: 3 inner folds, seed 0, argmin mean ln RRMS, ties to larger lambda
g_v2.primary: full data: g on all 18 at lambda*_full, in-sample refit of all 18; control C0_refit
g_v2.secondary: LODO: fold g at lambda*_h, held-out refit

scoring.primary: paper RRMS, frozen released-card curve set
scoring.secondary: M-rule (nMOS upstream measured rule; pMOS upstream thresholds on measured last trimmed point)

validity: V4 re-simulation reproduces stored RRMS within 1e-9
optional: Verilog-A element checks of the arm-B full-data g (I17-1 rules) if time allows
